# LangGraph launch intelligence

This graph alternates between an analyst model and specialized search nodes
until it can produce a product-launch intelligence brief.

SerpApi enhancement: web, news, and shopping searches expose distinct evidence
surfaces in the graph's tool node.

```bash
uv run --with . --with langgraph --with langchain-openai cookbook/langgraph/main.py
```

Read the
[complete cookbook entry](https://github.com/serpapi/serpapi-search-tools-python/tree/main/cookbook/langgraph)
or the official
[Agentic RAG example](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph/blob/main/examples/rag/langgraph_agentic_rag.ipynb).
